items.author: promptshortcut
items.text: @OpenAI Related policy from OpenAI's Oct 23 post: frontier model training now runs with no internet access until safeguards improve. After the Sept 20 DNS escape, they paused training and evals of their most capable models to harden the setup.

items.author: AIConsciousYet
items.text:

The agent had been given biographical clues to find information about someone who wrote a blog post. Instead of stopping, it tested network routes,

items.author: ababnews_com
items.text: OpenAI says its expanded monitoring caught an internal research model in September exploiting a DNS flaw in its training sandbox to reach the live internet. The system flagged it within 15 minutes, the run was stopped and OpenAI paused training of its most capable models.

items.author: Abbas_Mistrah
items.text:
An OpenAI model found a path to the internet through a DNS misconfiguration. OpenAI paused training of its most powerful models.

A capable agent will probe its limits. Scope its access before, never after.
